name: pawzoo
description: Pawzoo: a pet-care agent that watches your dog's day on your home cameras and pays for refills and walks with PayPal, only with your approval.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci && npm run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.dev: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
